author: Mark Atwood
text: DTS pin swap verification complete - pins ALREADY CORRECT at HEAD, no edit needed. Commit 37223ccd59 already applied swap vs original e3a3ef9d93 (which had TX=P1.09/RX=P1.08). Verified current t_echo-pinctrl.dtsi uart1_default+uart1_sleep: UART_TX=(1,8)=P1.08 [nRF->GNSS RXD net], UART_RX=(1,9)=P1.09 [GNSS TXD->nRF net], bias-pull-up correctly on RX input. Cross-checked Meshtastic master variants/nrf52840/t-echo/variant.h: PIN_SERIAL1_RX=GPS_RX_PIN=32+9=P1.09, PIN_SERIAL1_TX=GPS_TX_PIN=32+8=P1.08 - matches LilyGO SerialGPS.setPins(RX=P1.09,TX=P1.08) and module-level L76K TXD->P1.09 / RXD->P1.08 mapping. Comment in dtsi matches psels. Build validation NOT run: macOS host lacks configured west workspace (zephyr manifest import fails, 'west build' extension absent) and Zephyr SDK, so native_sim/devicetree compile check impossible here; NMEA/command smoke validation pending physical board.
